ns2:section.sectionText: Meets with FSHN 220. Additional coursework required for graduate credit. Enrollment in this section is limited to off-campus students. Degree-seeking FSHN MS Online students who have completed FSHN 595 XM: Nutrition for Health & Fitness cannot apply this course toward degree completion requirements. The section is not recommended for students who have taken or an entry-level nutrition course within the last 5-years. Center for Innovation in Teaching & Learning (CITL) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.citl.illinois.edu. Online scheduled class sessions require that each student have high speed internet access and either a headset with microphone or an external microphone and speakers so they may participate in the class discussions. This section has one or more proctored exams, which may carry additional fees. Proctoring options include fee-based ProctorU and approved proctoring centers. For ProctorU technical specifications and additional information visit: http://www.ao.uiuc.edu/support/source/student_services/proctoru_tech.html.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to MS: FSHN (Online) -UIUC, MS:FSci &Hmn Nutrition -UIUC, or NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: Graduate - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $394.00 per Bill Hour, Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $359.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $50.00 per Bill Hour.
